basics.name: Arshad Ahmed
basics.label: Design Engineer, Spatial and 3D Tools
basics.summary: Designs spatial tools and builds them, down to the renderer, by directing AI agents: owns the architecture, the specs and the review, and the agents write the code. Nearly five years on a production web-GIS platform for mining and drone survey.

work.name: Aereo
highlights: Took workflows that needed Global Mapper and AutoCAD on expensive hardware and made them run in a browser.
Established the design system, UX processes and research practice from zero, scaled across 3 simultaneous projects.
Replaced DGPS stockpile walkdowns with drone-based volumetrics processed in the cloud.
Own and operate an experimental deployment environment where ideas are prototyped on real data and pass a go/no-go gate before the sprint.
Led a small design team of full-time designers and interns, and set how design worked with 20+ engineers, PMs and data scientists.
